AUAudioUnitViewConfiguration.doc: A configuration object that describes how to present the audio unit’s user interface.

AUGenericView.doc: A view that provides a generic user interface for a Cocoa audio unit.

AUPannerView.doc: A view that provides a specialized user interface for a Cocoa-based panner audio unit.

AUViewController.doc: The base class to extend when creating a custom user interface for an audio unit.

CABTLEMIDIWindowController.doc: A window controller that displays nearby Bluetooth-based MIDI peripherals.

CAInterDeviceAudioViewController.doc: A view controller object that displays iOS devices that support inter-device audio.

CANetworkBrowserWindowController.doc: A window controller that displays available network audio devices.

AUCustomViewPersistentData.doc: A protocol that defines the methods an Audio Unit host calls to manage view data.

AUGenericViewDisplayFlags.doc: Flags that describe the display of a generic view.

AUViewParametersDisplayFlag.doc: If set, the generic view displays the audio unit parameters of the audio unit.

AUViewPropertiesDisplayFlag.doc: If set, the generic view displays the audio unit properties of the audio unit.

AUViewTitleDisplayFlag.doc: If set, the generic view displays the title and manufacturer of the audio unit.

-initWithAudioUnit:.doc: Creates a generic view for an audio unit, setting all display flags.

-initWithAudioUnit:displayFlags:.doc: Initializes a generic view for an audio unit, setting specific display flags.

+AUPannerViewWithAudioUnit:.doc: Creates a panner view for an audio unit.

+isAVBSupported.doc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the current machine hardware supports Audio Video Bridging (AVB).

-init.doc: Creates a new network browser window controller.

hostHasController.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the host shows its own control surface in this view configuration.

audioUnit.doc: The audio unit associated with the generic view.

showsExpertParameters.doc: Indicates whether or not controls for expert audio unit parameters are displayed in the generic view.

audioUnit.doc: The panner audio unit associated with the generic panner view.
